Seer.directive_rationale: Continue to establish your findings as the ground truth early in the day.

Guard.directive_rationale: Your sole priority is the Seer; protecting anyone else while the Seer is alive is an unacceptable risk.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Jin chose to protect Nhan instead of the Seer (Nam).

Guard.directive_rationale: You must maintain a Seer-only protection loop.

Witch.directive_rationale: This potion is reserved exclusively for the Seer.

Witch.verdict_notes: Hoang held the save potion in Round 1 and later used it on the Seer (Nam) in Round 2.

Villager.directive_rationale: When a player fails to provide a role claim under direct pressure, you must override caution and vote to exile them immediately to penalize the silence.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan and Cong (Villagers) both voted to exile Meg after she failed to provide a role claim despite direct pressure from Nam and others during the debate.
Villager.verdict_notes: The Villagers correctly identified Meg's silence under pressure and voted to exile her.
